trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.
2. **Rolled back**: all production regions to v2.3.0 via the rollback tool.
3. **Verified**: post-rollback, checkout-api reports healthy across all regions with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** titled "checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions," including the diagnostics and remediation steps. On-call has been paged.

Recommendation: hold v2.3.1 from any further deploys until the root cause of the health-check failures is identified (v2.3.1-rc also showed unhealthy in staging, so this was likely foreseeable).
